GOLDMAN SACHS RAISES BRENT OIL FORECAST TO $85

Goldman Sachs raised its December Brent crude forecast to $85 a barrel as energy prices climb across Asia-Pacific.

The Iran war and Strait of Hormuz closure have tightened supplies, pushing LNG and diesel prices to yearly highs.
